question: What is the supported agent-ID rename contract for explicit workspace paths and plugin-owned persistent state?
rationale: Those choices determine user-visible path behavior, transaction boundaries, rollback guarantees, and the permanent plugin API; they cannot be safely inferred from the current runtime guard.

options.title: Adopt a conservative core rename contract
options.body: Preserve explicit workspace paths, move only OpenClaw-owned default paths, and require plugins to opt into a typed validated migration hook.

options.title: Limit the first release to core-owned state
options.body: Ship a narrowly scoped rename only when no participating plugin-owned persistent state is present, then design plugin participation separately.

options.title: Defer the feature pending broader agent-state design
options.body: Keep the ownership guard and defer renaming until the repository has a settled cross-plugin state-migration contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt a conservative core rename contract
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit workspace paths, move only OpenClaw-owned default paths, and require plugins to opt into a typed validated migration hook.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has already documented the decision points and concrete safety constraints, making them the best available routing contact from the supplied evidence.
